summary: SCYNEXIS filed an 8-K on September 28, 2026 disclosing entry on September 25, 2026 into a BARDA Award/Contract for development of SCY-247, its second-generation fungerp antifungal candidate. The contract provides up to $214 million in potential non-dilutive federal funding, with an initial base period of roughly $18.5 million supporting oral and intravenous SCY-247 into a Phase 2 invasive candidiasis study; the balance requires BARDA to exercise up to six options over a potential ten-year term. No securities, ownership, or change-of-control terms are involved.
